root_cause.native_completion: Custody of candidate succeeded; refresh failed at projection2058884 > hard2000000; uncertain() then masked the failure as operation_already_returned.
root_cause.transport_growth: Legacy wire repeated in result text/meta and partial text/base64 inflates mandatory control projection.

mechanism.projection: Explicit monotonic sizing bounded by store.MAX_JSON_BYTES; complete q/p preserved, model wire admission remains independent.
mechanism.custody: Recognize verified completed operation before uncertainty; preserve stale/integration error without relabeling returned data.
mechanism.future_transport: Exact full wire in immutable scoped runtime._artifact; q only carries pinned receipt. read_wire verifies path,scope,artifact hash,wire hash/bytes and guard. Complete SSE archived after source exhaustion and terminal marker; partial remains UNCERTAIN.
mechanism.semantics: observe_stream unchanged, semantic response stays whole. No semantic compression, no migration/pruning of legacy records, no automatic acceptance.

tests.integrity: 4 current source pins matched;4 staged files copied byte-identical and compiled locally.

test_harness.offline: Socket/DNS/subprocess denied; writes outside workspace denied. Live DB extracted by readonly URI into one-context subset.
test_harness.artifact_bridge: Old absolute source pins resolved read-only through original immutable artifacts; all newly created artifacts/journals isolated.
test_harness.negative_tests: SSE truncated/split/invalidUTF8, tampered artifact prevents ACK, wrong byte count/scope refused, replay/broken admission pin/visible overflow, injected stale custody and broken result verifier.

limits: No installation/restart/provider or UI integration test by this sidecar. Main owns routing/stream/UI and deploy.
Original requests and legacy transport records remain untouched; this does not reconcile uncertain response.
iter_lines reconstruction preserves yielded values joined with LF, not original HTTP delimiters.
Bounded32MiB control projection can still refuse; provider context/token admission unchanged.
Wire archive and journal storage still grow with actual received data; no infinite-memory claim.
